We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike. Tecovas is looking for a Sourcing Specialist, Supply Chain to support the growth and expansion of our supply chain across footwear, apparel, and accessories. Reporting directly to the Sr. Category Manager, you will own purchase order placement and critical sourcing data, monitor production timelines, support vendor management, and help improve the processes and tools that keep product moving from concept to customer. This role is required to be based in Austin, TX. Candidates must either be currently located in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX. What you’ll do: Own purchase order writing and maintenance across footwear, apparel, and accessories, ensuring accurate and timely placement and updates. Maintain sourcing and vendor data in our product lifecycle management (PLM) system, including PO due dates, costing grids, HTS codes, commercial terms, and lead times. Own the Sourcing SOP library, keeping documentation current and translating system or process changes into clear training and vendor communication. Drive vendor data compliance in partnership with Logistics, Accounting, Sourcing Operations, and vendors, identifying root causes and resolving recurring ASN and billing issues. jobs.description_text: Tecovas was founded with the simple goal of making the world's best western boots, apparel and leather goods - and selling them at a fair price. We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike. Tecovas is looking for a Store Assortment Planner to help get the right assortment into every one of our stores. Brattle Associates also benefit from continuous formal and informal training and development opportunities. Brattle is committed to being a multi-generational firm, with many of our Associates developing into Principals and testifying experts. Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.
